mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Sun-Blessed Healer: "When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target nonland
# permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield."
# ZNR Nullpriest of Oblivion's B6-etb-kicked-trigger (verified) with the target narrowed to a
# nonland permanent card (Into the Roil's filter; IS_PERMANENT is a type-line test off the
# battlefield) of mana value 2 or less (CMC_LE).
reanimate = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.WAS_KICKED),
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_PERMANENT),
                    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land')),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CMC_LE, count=QConst(value=2)),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
        ),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
    }),
)
# compiled: [0] the kicker head, [1] the creature carrier
abilities = [compiled[0], reanimate, compiled[1]]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target nonland permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
